question: The value of {{428 times 428 times 428 + 348 times 348 times 348} over 428 times 428 - 428 times 348 + 348 times 348}
solution:
**Given:**

{{428 times 428 times 428 + 348 times 348 times 348} over 428 times 428 - 428 times 348 + 348 times 348}

**Concept used:**

(a + b) = (a³ + b³)/a² - ab + b²

**Calculation:**

{{428 times 428 times 428 + 348 times 348 times 348} over 428 times 428 - 428 times 348 + 348 times 348}

Using (a + b) = (a3 + b3)/a2 - ab + b2

⇒ (428³+348³)/(428²- 428times 348 + 348²)=428+348=776

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
